digest.component_or_area: code_health metrics - scc LOC analyzer adapter
propositions: scc LOC analyzer must invoke scc via subprocess with --format json flag and parse resulting JSON to extract per-file Code and Location fields
analyzer returns AnalyzerResult with loc payload containing repo-relative POSIX-normalized file paths and max_loc value
analyzer returns Unavailable with reason when scc binary is missing, exits non-zero, produces empty/unparseable stdout, or JSON parse fails
successful empty scc output (empty file list) returns AnalyzerResult with empty files dict and max_loc=0, not Unavailable
scc_loc.py is self-contained in analyzers package with injectable run parameter for testability, no cross-layer coupling to grounding
